set.body: Derive topology from TriangleMesh instead of storing an opaque graph: unique undirected edges, adjacency lists, edge lengths, vertex degrees, face areas, vertex normals, Euler characteristic, and optional Laplacian/adjacency matrix views using existing scalar containers. Acceptance: tetrahedron and open two-triangle fixtures match expected edge counts/distances/areas; no graph-library dependency leaks into public core types. Likely paths: modules/surface/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/surface/topology, modules/surface/shared/src/test/scala/scalafim/surface.
set.title: Mesh topology views and geometry metrics
